description: Corpus pointers for feedback_gym. Synthetic demo ships in-repo so the gym runs without muse-eeg-heads on disk. Sibling findings-only corpora are built by windwerfer/neurofeed-gym-corpora (--corpus-root) into gitignored corpora/external/.

synthetic.notes: Wake then drowsy regimes; band ratios + relative bands + precomputed AI score columns + drowsy labels.

external.cal_policy: first cal_n=90 samples of concatenated test stream (sessions typically start wake/low-y)
external.ai: softmax P(class1) from emb @ W.T + b; CBraMod W(2,200); REVE W(2,512) subsample-aligned; no encoder forward
external.notes: REVE columns optional (subsample emb_cache, NaN-padded). Falls back to synthetic if paths missing.

external.upstream: Lee et al., Sci Data 2026, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.30162868 (Muse 2 native AF7/AF8/TP9/TP10)
external.ai: none (band columns only) -> ai.* scored N/A
external.notes: findings-only: eval -> aggregate. Built NPZ is gitignored; only aggregate numbers (scores, sep, percentile bands, keep/merge/kill) may land in neurofeed PRs. No raw/windows/embeddings, no NC/gated data, ever. Attribute Lee et al. (CC-BY) when citing aggregates.

external.builder_status: planned (~20 GB upstream); corpora-repo manifest currently names the default out universe_load.npz, the gym preset passes --out universe_stress.npz
external.ai: none (band columns only) -> ai.* scored N/A
external.notes: findings-only: eval -> aggregate. Built NPZ is gitignored; only aggregate numbers (scores, sep, percentile bands, keep/merge/kill) may land in neurofeed PRs. No raw/windows/embeddings, no NC/gated data, ever. Attribute UNIVERSE authors (CC-BY) when citing aggregates.

external.builder_status: stub: upstream ships pre-extracted feature MATs, not raw EEG; builder exits 2 until raw Muse S streams are available

external.notes: findings-only: eval -> aggregate. Built NPZ is gitignored; only aggregate numbers (scores, sep, percentile bands, keep/merge/kill) may land in neurofeed PRs. No raw/windows/embeddings, no NC/gated data, ever. Attribute alkabbany et al. (CC-BY) when citing aggregates.

external.how_to_wire: Prefer --preset sleep-edf-test (builds NPZ). Or point --corpus at any NPZ matching demo_session schema.

schema.per_recording_calibration: Optional cal_starts int32 (R,) + cal_lens int32 (R,), one entry per unique recording_id in first-appearance order (== recordings_used). cal_starts are absolute stream row indices; the block [start, start+len) must lie inside that recording. Each recording is scored against its own baseline; cal rows are excluded from scoring; cal_len 0 skips the recording. Absent -> legacy: first cal_n rows.
